typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	sFileName as string (),
	OLEDBDestination2_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		businessDate as string,
		sciId as string,
		customerLongName as string,
		portfolioGroup as string,
		productClass as string,
		productGroup as string,
		product as string,
		measure as string,
		wleId as string,
		wleShortName as string,
		tradingCounterpartyId as string,
		tradingCounterpartyName as string,
		limitDescription as string,
		limitStatus as string,
		subLimit as string,
		dealCount as string,
		bdg as string,
		limitActive as string,
		limitStep1 as string,
		limitValue1 as string,
		expMaxValue as string,
		netMTM as string,
		nonLimitValue as string,
		tenorWarning as string,
		expirationDate as string,
		limitStep2 as string,
		limitValue2 as string,
		expMax2 as string,
		limitStep3 as string,
		expMax3limitStep4 as string,
		limitValue4 as string,
		expMax4 as string,
		limitStep5 as string,
		limitValue5 as string,
		ultParentId as string,
		ultParentName as string,
		countryRiskName as string,
		countryDomName as string,
		rmLastName as string,
		rmFirstName as string,
		WBContact as string,
		wbContact2 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource	source(output(
		File_Nm as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE
FlatFileSource derive(Create_dt = currentTimestamp(),
		File_Nm = toString($sFileName),
		NewBusinessDte = toString(replace(businessDate, toString('\"'), toString(''))),
		WBContact_New = toString(trim(replace(replace(WBContact, toString(','), toString('')), toString('\r'), toString(''))))) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn,LookupLKPTABLE lookup(DerivedColumn@File_Nm == LookupLKPTABLE@File_Nm,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookup
Lookup select(mapColumn(
		Create_dt = Create_dt,
		File_Nm = DerivedColumn@File_Nm,
		NewBusinessDte = NewBusinessDte,
		WBContact_New = WBContact_New,
		businessDate = businessDate,
		sciId = sciId,
		customerLongName = customerLongName,
		portfolioGroup = portfolioGroup,
		productClass = productClass,
		productGroup = productGroup,
		product = product,
		measure = measure,
		wleId = wleId,
		wleShortName = wleShortName,
		tradingCounterpartyId = tradingCounterpartyId,
		tradingCounterpartyName = tradingCounterpartyName,
		limitDescription = limitDescription,
		limitStatus = limitStatus,
		subLimit = subLimit,
		dealCount = dealCount,
		bdg = bdg,
		limitActive = limitActive,
		limitStep1 = limitStep1,
		limitValue1 = limitValue1,
		expMaxValue = expMaxValue,
		netMTM = netMTM,
		nonLimitValue = nonLimitValue,
		tenorWarning = tenorWarning,
		expirationDate = expirationDate,
		limitStep2 = limitStep2,
		limitValue2 = limitValue2,
		expMax2 = expMax2,
		limitStep3 = limitStep3,
		expMax3limitStep4 = expMax3limitStep4,
		limitValue4 = limitValue4,
		expMax4 = expMax4,
		limitStep5 = limitStep5,
		limitValue5 = limitValue5,
		ultParentId = ultParentId,
		ultParentName = ultParentName,
		countryRiskName = countryRiskName,
		countryDomName = countryDomName,
		rmLastName = rmLastName,
		rmFirstName = rmFirstName,
		WBContact = WBContact,
		wbContact2 = wbContact2
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Lookup01
Lookup01 filter(!isMatch()) ~> Lookup0
Lookup0 sink(input(
		wleShortName as string,
		nonLimitValue as string,
		tenorWarning as string,
		limitValue4 as string,
		limitValue5 as string,
		limitValue2 as string,
		limitValue1 as string,
		tradingCounterpartyId as string,
		countryRiskName as string,
		Create_dt as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		expMax3limitStep4 as string,
		businessDate as string,
		limitStatus as string,
		limitDescription as string,
		wleId as string,
		expMaxValue as string,
		sciId as string,
		customerLongName as string,
		countryDomName as string,
		rmFirstName as string,
		tradingCounterpartyName as string,
		ultParentName as string,
		NewBusinessDte as string,
		expirationDate as string,
		subLimit as string,
		wbContact2 as string,
		File_Nm as string,
		limitActive as string,
		product as string,
		expMax2 as string,
		productClass as string,
		bdg as string,
		expMax4 as string,
		WBContact as string,
		ultParentId as string,
		portfolioGroup as string,
		rmLastName as string,
		measure as string,
		netMTM as string,
		productGroup as string,
		limitStep3 as string,
		limitStep5 as string,
		dealCount as string,
		limitStep2 as string,
		limitStep1 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,errorHandlingOption: 'allErrors',reportSuccessOnError: true,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		wleShortName,
		nonLimitValue,
		tenorWarning,
		limitValue4,
		limitValue5,
		limitValue2,
		limitValue1,
		tradingCounterpartyId,
		countryRiskName,
		Create_dt,
		expMax3limitStep4,
		businessDate,
		limitStatus,
		limitDescription,
		wleId,
		expMaxValue,
		sciId,
		customerLongName,
		countryDomName,
		rmFirstName,
		tradingCounterpartyName,
		ultParentName,
		NewBusinessDte,
		expirationDate,
		subLimit,
		wbContact2,
		File_Nm,
		limitActive,
		product,
		expMax2,
		productClass,
		bdg,
		expMax4,
		WBContact = WBContact_New,
		ultParentId,
		portfolioGroup,
		rmLastName,
		measure,
		netMTM,
		productGroup,
		limitStep3,
		limitStep5,
		dealCount,
		limitStep2,
		limitStep1),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination2_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination2
